report: The trailer scheduling conflict is resolved. C gets the first slot — the earliest weekend she can haul materials in the next few weeks — then hands the trailer to A, with alternate weekends available to either after that. A and C both confirmed the order; B accepted the plan and asked only to be told the final dates and that the trailer move off her pad eventually. C will message A with her exact weekend and copy B and me. No change to B's pad was proposed, so no landlord approval is needed.
